title: The Grand Fowl Mansion

intro.speaker: Lord Puddle
intro.text: Detective, a guest has taken ill. Someone here carried the Poison Vial.

intro.speaker: Detective
intro.text: Six suspects, six rooms, six hours, six items. Let's fill the board.

clues: Sir Quacksalot insists he never left the Grand Foyer.
Lord Puddle was found in the Conservatory.
Duchess Down retired to the Cellar.
Count Plucker stargazed from the Rooftop.
Baron Billow was seen in the Library.
Duchess Down's bedside clock read midnight.
Lady Waddle arrived before Baron Billow.
The Candlestick belongs to Sir Quacksalot.
Lord Puddle was wrapped in the Velvet Rope.
The Pocket Watch was returned to Count Plucker.
The Poison Vial was discovered in the Library.
Lady Waddle refused to hold the Crowbar.
The Pocket Watch was never in the Kitchen.
errors: That doesn't fit the witness statement.

ending.revelation: Baron Billow carried the Poison Vial in the Library at 11pm. The case is closed.

collectible.name: Golden Feather
collectible.description: A keepsake from your first solved case.

ending.hook: A sealed invitation has arrived. Another mystery awaits when you are ready.
